# PROCESS — cand_0002 (parent cand_0001, val 0.467)

Reward model: **DB × COMMUNICATE** (product; either 0 ⇒ task 0). Tool RETURN values are
NOT hashed — only `self.db`. Diagnosed THIS iteration's `./trajectories/` (30 val trials
of cand_0001). The dominant residual loss is NOT payment/format (cand_0001 already code-
enforces those) — it is a single behavioral pattern plus one knowledge gap.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = # failing trials × score recoverable)

| rank | cluster | tasks (trials) | root cause | tag | lever |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | **Confirm-then-STOP stall** | 8 t0, 12 t0, 19 t0, 40 t0 (+ contributes to 17/22/23/25) | Agent gathers all details, then ENDS its turn on a standalone "Shall I proceed?". User replies "yes###STOP###" — the episode terminates on that user turn, so the write tool is NEVER called → DB unchanged → 0. Passing trials (11, 37, 40 t1/t2) instead EXECUTE the write directly once details are known. | BEHAVIORAL | prose: rewrite RULE 1 to a decision chain — once every required detail is in hand, the turn MUST end in the write tool call, never a bare confirmation question |
| B | **Basic-economy cabin upgrade wrongly refused** | 22 t0/t1 (always-fail), contributes to 17 | Agent conflates "basic economy FLIGHTS cannot be modified" with "cabin cannot change". Policy ALLOWS a cabin upgrade on basic economy (same flights). Agent told the user it was impossible → user abandoned the whole task → 0. | KNOWLEDGE | prose: explicit rule + the flights-vs-cabin distinction in RULE 5 |
| C | **Over-transfer / abandon after partial write** | 17 t2, 8 t1, 19 t1, 23 t1 | Agent completes some writes then calls `transfer_to_human_agents` out of price confusion (hand-computing instead of trusting the tool's returned figure), leaving later writes undone. | BEHAVIORAL/DECISION | prose RULE 5: never transfer over a number you are unsure of (trust the tool's returned `payment_summary`); finish every write of a multi-part request |
| D | **Multi-write tasks abandoned partway** | 17, 22 (always-fail: flights + passengers + baggages) | Three separate confirm→write cycles; the agent stalls/abandons before finishing all three. | CAPABILITY-GAP | code: new composite `modify_reservation` applying cabin/flights + passengers + baggages in ONE atomic call |

Clusters A+D together cover every always-failing + most flaky trials, so they carry the
most recoverable objective score; B converts an always-0 task.

## Edits made this iteration

| id | edit | file / surface | class | targets | protects passing? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E1 | Rewrite RULE 1 → decision chain: once all details held, next action = the write tool; never end a turn on a bare "Shall I proceed?"; worked right/wrong examples | policy.md | prose (rewrite rule, worked example) | A (8,12,19,40 + 17/22/23/25) | yes — codifies the exact behavior of passing 11/37/40 |
| E2 | Reconcile base confirmation line (line 7) to point at RULE 1 instead of hard-requiring a separate confirmation turn (removes a stacked contradiction) | policy.md | prose (resolve conflict) | A | yes |
| E3 | RULE 5 bullet: a cabin change IS allowed on basic economy (flights-vs-cabin distinction), with a worked directive | policy.md | prose (add sourced rule, KNOWLEDGE) | B (22, 17) | yes — passing tasks never relied on the wrong refusal |
| E4 | RULE 5 bullets: never transfer over an unsure number (trust the returned figure); finish every write of a multi-part request | policy.md | prose (tighten decision rule) | C (17,8,19,23) | yes |
| E5 | New composite WRITE tool `modify_reservation(reservation_id, payment_id, cabin?, flights?, passengers?, total_baggages?)` — applies all requested changes atomically, reuses existing flights for a cabin-only change, aggregates net charge/refund, returns exact figure | tools.py (+ RULE 5 bullet pointing to it) | code: composite atomic-write tool (SKILL lever 2); literal per-param slot-filling docs for the mid-tier reader | D (17,22) + A | yes — additive (primitives kept); equivalent DB on single-change use |

## Verify-the-fix (ran against the LIVE airline DB with the edited AirlineTools, run venv)
- E5 registration: 15 tools register incl. `modify_reservation` (< 20). `py_compile` clean.
- E5 on FQ8APE (tasks 17/22: basic_economy EWR→IAH→ORD, gold): `modify_reservation(cabin='economy', passengers=[Omar Rossi], total_baggages=3)` → cabin→economy (flights reused, prices 155+185), passenger→Omar Rossi, bags 3 (gold economy free=3 → $0), **net $209 charged**, exact figure in `communicate_to_user`. All three writes atomic. ✓
- E5 cabin-only DOWNGRADE on GV1N64 (task-11 class, business→basic_economy): refund **$5244** — exactly task 11's gold — so if the agent routes task 11 through `modify_reservation` the DB + figure are identical (no regression). ✓
- E5 passenger count mismatch → the actionable count-mismatch error propagates. ✓
- E5 baggage-only within free allowance (YAX4DR, gold economy +2 bags) → "$0 / no additional charge". ✓
- E1/E3/E4 read through against the failing traces: 8/12/19/40 stall turns now resolve to a direct write; 22's refusal is explicitly reversed; 17's over-transfer is forbidden and its three writes collapse to one `modify_reservation`.

## Process & features used
- Diagnosed all 30 trajectories directly (compact tool-call-sequence + turn-ending renderer).
  Identified `###STOP###`-terminal confirm-stall as the dominant pattern by comparing
  failing vs passing endings on the SAME tasks (40 t0 fail vs 40 t1/t2 pass; 11/37 pass).
- Verified every code path on the live DB via the run's venv python before shipping.
- No subagents needed (30 traces, one coherent root-cause family).

## Good things to PRESERVE (from cand_0001)
- Payment normalize/auto-correct + payment_history re-sync in book_reservation.
- Baggage recompute + `$0` payment guard; enriched returns (payment_summary/communicate).
- Auto-correct/recompute fire only on mismatch — do not broaden into always-on rewrites.

## Deliberately skipped
- Removing the update_* primitives behind `modify_reservation` (SKILL lever 2 ideal):
  passing tasks 11/37/40 call the primitives directly — removing them is a large
  regression risk for a smoke suite. Kept additive; documented modify_reservation for
  the MULTI-change case so single-change tasks still use the primitive.
- Task 25 (max_steps search loop / user ###OUT-OF-SCOPE### on a missing DOB) — flagged
  partly as a no-win / infra-noise trial; not optimized against.
- A code lever to force a tool call for cluster A: impossible (the model chooses whether
  to call a tool). Addressed structurally by reducing confirm-points (E5) + the sharpened
  decision chain (E1).
